build_FoldingTrunk: build a protein folding trunk model with configurable triangular self-attention blocks and recycling iterations
run_FoldingTrunk_forward: run the folding trunk forward pass with sequence features, pair features, residue indices, and a mask
create_FoldingTrunkConfig: create a FoldingTrunkConfig dataclass to set num_blocks, sequence_state_dim, pairwise_state_dim, and max_recycles
run_FoldingTrunk_distogram: run the distogram static method to compute pairwise CB distance bins from N, CA, C coordinates
create_RelativePosition: create a RelativePosition embedding module that encodes pairwise residue index differences into embeddings
